violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (3 bay sink ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The ice machine is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The dumpster outside is located on (dirt). The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The floors in kitchen and bar have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The (walls ) in the (women's restroom ) area is in poor repair. Cracked/damaged tiles The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch.PIC informed. Ice disposed. Unit taken out of service to be washed and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2024
The outside dumpster is not covered. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2024
Outside dumpster area observed with an accumulation of trash, litter, and/or other debris. Refuse areas be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2024

The floors under the prep tables and 3 bay sink have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2024
